records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Systems
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad to have Cedar Systems on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Owen replied positively and unprompted (email:bfe1be58), and already created a project on day 1 (first_project reached), showing real momentum. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6, no invites sent, and his tone is passive ("all good", call "at some point"), with 8 days left on Starter solo. Moderate odds unaided.

draft.subject: Happy to do that walkthrough
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for the note 
delighted things are going smoothly so far, and the walkthrough offer stands whenever you want it. Would a short call this week suit? I can keep it to 20 minutes and focus on whatever is most useful to Cedar Systems 
whether that's getting more out of your first project or bringing colleagues in.

For context, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Just reply with a couple of times that work.

Best,
Nadia
